operations.notes: Same transaction creates the world, the initial advance lease and the root point generation=1 head claim and gate; no generation=0 claim path exists. worldId is server-assigned; the same requestId returns the same world.

includeRecovery=true validates the live lease/epoch, then returns active accepted restoreSources independently of payload visibility for current and reserved successor work. Sources include the old epoch/attempt and hashes needed to build restore requests, but no raw text or candidates. If copying is needed, payloadStatus=restore_required with groups=[] and timeScanCandidates=null; after copying, payloadStatus=available returns only current-epoch bytes. Missing/corrupt payload rows do not erase accepted references or authorize resampling. Consumed/abandoned sources are excluded; ordinary reads return recovery=null. Invalid/old lease cannot read frozen text. No requestId; the only response carrying activeInput. Context never returns lease or claim tokens.

Starts the player chain only after the ready root/last handback. IDs must be allocated, unused and world-bound. Validate the frozen character order against the authoritative world. Persist text only in active input storage; data and idempotency records contain identities only. Initialize select_actor/cursor=0.
Saves the preallocated pointId, kind, baseline head/version/digest and timeAdvance; working progress initializes from committed progress.
First confirmed action/target/skip/time-scan locks time in the same transaction; afterwards an explicit cancel chain is the only way to change it.
select_actor→build_group. Stores model goals only; admission is recomputed from rolls and the eligibility baseline. Committed cursor/order/acted/visited and working progress stay untouched.

Exactly one of complete target set for a source or one admitted member with its action and judgment references. Confirmed targets and actions are final; members only grow; group results are not consumed here.
build_group→settle_group; server requires every target analysed and an empty frontier. Closed groups are read-only for membership, targets and actions.

settle_group→select_actor. Appends one complete six-stage candidate set in order, advances working fields, clears the active pendingGroup slot without deleting its text or results. Same requestId replays; a changed candidate for a staged group is rejected. Never writes world deltas or committed progress.
Records the skip of the current legal slot; never adds to actedIds. Characters already in actedIds are skipped programmatically.
Saves the complete no-action time-scan stage candidates at a legal point boundary; workingActedIds is not extended and task/personality/sanity checks cannot be skipped.
An empty point must have its time-scan candidates saved first. After sealing, no candidate can be added or changed; only points consumes the prefix.

Seals the current prefix and creates the single direct successor reservation with fixed successor time and baseline binding; committed cursors do not move. Until the predecessor commits, only this successor's boundary-source discover/extend and its rolls are allowed.

Takeover continuation: the server byte-copies server-accepted frozen work (action text, targets, results, stage candidates) into the current epoch after verifying accepted-source records, scope and every hash against active references. The input source metadata is available from context.recovery.*.restoreSources before copying. The request has no destination attempt. After validating authority and sources, the transaction allocates a positive, monotonically increasing attempt within (worldId, pointId, groupId), across epochs, and returns pointId/groupId/fenceEpoch/attempt as the accepted copy identity. RequestId replay returns the original data; a new requestId with the same business key reuses the accepted copy and attempt without allocating again. The business manifest projection sorts by memberId and includes all source content hashes. Both open and sealed current/reserved work can be copied; consumed or abandoned sources fail frozen_work_missing with details.reason=source_not_active. Missing/corrupt bytes fail explicitly and never authorize model resampling. Passes through gate and pause; group, time, cursor, sealed flag, prefix digest, candidates, phase and revision stay unchanged.
Allowed through the narration gate; idempotent when already paused. Phase, work and gate are preserved; claim TTL is not extended.

resolve_gate runs in-transaction: expired or fenced gates are cleared and reported via blockedReasons while the resume itself succeeds with canCompute=false. Resume is never an authorization to compute.

continue requires a non-empty legal candidate set and an unallocated nextRoundId; the successor automatic round inherits the advance. handback ends the input chain and clears its text. Neither moves the world head.

Explicit cancel from the last full commit point; still requires a ready head but is allowed while paused. Abandons current and reserved work with terminal identity records; frozen copies survive until their last active reference goes.
Grants a free lease or takes over an expired one with a new fenceEpoch; lease_invalid with details.reason=lease_held reports another holder's still valid lease. The token travels only in data.
Extends expiry for the matching token and epoch; token and fenceEpoch persist.
Releases the matching lease; parameters travel in the query string.

Preallocates advance/input/round/group/task/change/point/trigger identities per stable slot keys; the same slot key always returns the same ID. Committed IDs are never reallocated. rollId is deliberately absent: rolls allocates it.

Recomputes candidates from the authoritative baseline (max 32 units, request JSON up to 512 KiB, response up to 2 MiB); over budget returns preview_budget_exceeded with details.limit=request|response. preview carries no requestId and never enters the idempotency table.

Server-side dice keyed by (worldId, roundId, groupId, sourceId, targetId, triggerKey); the same key returns the original row. One INSERT with the final eligibility/admission result; no NULL-admission intermediate rows.

Same transaction applies locked time and staged candidates, verifies settlementGroups against settledUnits (identity, members, order), promotes working progress, saves the next control position with a generation=1 head claim and gate, and cleans only this point's consumed groups. Pure-time points commit with an empty settlementGroups list using the saved time-scan candidates.
Committed points in timeline order.
Rebuilds the state at a committed point from the canonical projection.

A fresh requestId with the valid head lease (or a valid currentClaim for history) retrieves the still-valid claim. Successful requestId replay returns summary without token; expired or fenced authority cannot retrieve it. Returns the issued claim for a valid claim; only invalidation, retry or regeneration rotates the generation and token. This is the only response that may carry claimToken. Head mode requires the valid advance lease; history mode operates on the point claim only and borrows no lease.
Extends the matching claim's expiry without changing generation or token; long generations renew instead of re-claiming.

Commits text or a failure code against generation, claimToken and issued epoch. Cache write, point ready and matching-gate clearing share one transaction; phase, paused and checkpoint revision never change. Same generation and text replays the original success; a changed text is rejected.
Reads narration status, current generation and its text; never a lease check.
Deletes the cache and invalidates the matching generation; world facts are never deleted.
